ABOUT SANGHAPATHWAYS TOUR INDIA

Rooted in Bodh Gaya.
Connected by the journey.

We bring pilgrimage planning, local guiding and road travel together, helping you experience sacred places with time for discovery and reflection.

SANGHAPATHWAYS TOUR INDIA

OUR STORY STARTS HERE

A place of meaning.
A personal welcome.

Bodh Gaya is our home and the starting point for many of the journeys we plan. From time at the Mahabodhi Temple to visits across the wider Buddhist circuit, Sanghapathways Tour India helps bring the practical details of your pilgrimage together.

Our itineraries range from a three-day stay in Bodh Gaya to longer journeys through India and Nepal. Along the way, we coordinate travel and guide enquiries around your route, your companions and the experience you want to have.

Whether you are travelling individually, with family or as a pilgrimage group, we start by listening.

HOW WE APPROACH YOUR JOURNEY

Care in the details.
Meaning in the moments.

01 / THOUGHTFUL PLANNING

People before a programme.

We discuss your time, priorities and travel needs so that the route works for the people taking it.

02 / RESPECT FOR PLACE

Travel with consideration.

Sacred sites are living places of worship. Our approach makes room for local customs, quiet reflection and a respectful visit.

03 / PERSONAL CONNECTION

A conversation, from the start.

Speak to us directly about your itinerary, transport and guiding needs, and agree the arrangements before you travel.
